page_title: INT 2-0 FRO | Inter v Frosinone 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Inter take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+3' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Stefano Turati is alert and denies him.
90+1' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The ball is laid off to Nicolo Barella (Inter) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Stefano Turati to make a decent save.
89' Good defending. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) tries to find Lautaro Martinez inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
87' Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
86' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Federico Dionisi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
86' Stefano Sensi (Inter) poorly executes the free kick and the ball only hits the wall.
84' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
83' The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.

83' That's unlucky! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.
82' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Reinier and he is replaced by Kaio Jorge (Frosinone).
82' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Enzo Barrenechea.
81' A substitution has been made. Federico Dimarco goes off and Carlos Augusto (Inter) comes on.
81' Here is a change. Hakan Calhanoglu is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Stefano Sensi (Inter).
80' Matias Soule (Frosinone) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
79' Matias Soule (Frosinone) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
78' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
76' Reinier (Frosinone) commits a rough challenge and Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for an infringement.
74' Matias Soule (Frosinone) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

73' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Yann Sommer shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Frosinone force their opponents to concede a corner.
71' A yellow card for a tackle by Marco Brescianini (Frosinone). Federico Dionisi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
70' It will be a substitution. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) is ready to enter the pitch as Marcus Thuram walks off.
69' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Davide Frattesi (Inter) replacing Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
69' A pass by Matias Soule (Frosinone) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
68' Matias Soule (Frosinone) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
67' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
65' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Inter.

64' Federico Dimarco plays a lovely pass into Nicolo Barella (Inter), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
63' A snap shot by Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Yann Sommer produces a good save to thwart him.
61' Substitution. Denzel Dumfries walks off the pitch and Stefan de Vrij (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
59' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
58' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

57' What a chance that is! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the left post!
56' Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
55' It's time for a substitution. Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) comes on in place of Marvin Cuni.
55' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) replaces Pol Lirola.
53' 4:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
51' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
48' 2 - 0 Goal! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Stefano Turati into the bottom right corner.
48' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is going to take the penalty!

47' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) brought his opponent down. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Inter are awarded a penalty.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Matias Soule (Frosinone) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
44' Marcus Thuram (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

43' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Federico Dimarco (Inter) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top of the net. Stefano Turati just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
42' Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes well wide of the right post.
40' A pass by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
37' Stefano Turati comes off his line to intercept the corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
37' The ball is cleared after Lautaro Martinez (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.

36' Nicolo Barella (Inter) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
36' The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
36' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
35' Problems for Eusebio Di Francesco as Luca Mazzitelli is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) replaces him.
34' A lofted cross from Nicolo Barella (Inter) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
34' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
31' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' Pol Lirola (Frosinone) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
26' Frosinone can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
23' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
22' A cross from Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
21' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marcus Thuram (Inter).
20' Frosinone work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
19' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

19' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Stefano Turati, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Inter get a corner.
17' Matias Soule (Frosinone) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
16' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

15' Marcus Thuram (Inter) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Stefano Turati guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Matias Soule (Frosinone) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
11' The corner by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
10' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

8' That's a well-taken pass by Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
7' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
4' Marcus Thuram (Inter) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
3' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Inter manage to earn a corner.

The players are out at last! Frosinone will take the kick-off.
